integrity: Exhaustive state-switch parameterization with separate Euler-tour cycle enumeration and two independently implemented greedy parsing procedures; no independent human audit or historical-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite census for binary de Bruijn order five only; greedy pair-reference LZ and novLZ phrase counts, not bit lengths or higher orders.
title: Exact rooted LZ77 overlap-cost spectrum for binary order-five de Bruijn cycles
